categories.main_business_segments: CROWN CONFECTIONERY CO., LTD primarily operates in the manufacturing and sales of confectionery products including biscuits, candies, chocolates, snacks, and pies. The company focuses on product development and maintains multiple long-standing brands, distributing products nationwide through direct sales offices and dealerships. It also pursues overseas market expansion, notably in China.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced confectionery manufacturing technologies with production facilities in Daejeon, Jincheon, and Asan. Production capacity is calculated based on line-specific hourly output, operating hours, and annual production days. The company emphasizes product quality upgrades and efficiency improvements through new plant construction and production line modernization.
categories.primary_customers_markets: CROWN CONFECTIONERY serves a broad consumer base including children, youth, and adults across South Korea. Its products are distributed through large discount stores, convenience stores (CVS), online channels, and traditional retail outlets. The company also supplies military and institutional customers and exports products internationally, particularly targeting the Chinese market.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily within South Korea with production plants located in Daejeon, Jincheon, and Asan. It has nationwide distribution networks covering all provinces and cities. Additionally, it is actively developing overseas markets, especially in China, to secure growth opportunities.
categories.supply_chain_position: CROWN CONFECTIONERY operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain as a manufacturer of confectionery products. It sources raw materials, many of which are imported, processes them into finished goods, and distributes these products through its sales and logistics networks to end consumers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes continuous new product development aligned with consumer trends such as premiumization, health functionality, and wellness. Its R&D is organized into specialized teams focusing on biscuits, candies, and snacks, collaborating closely with marketing for market research and competitive analysis. Investments in production efficiency and brand value enhancement are strategic priorities.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of confectionery items including biscuits, candies, chocolates, and snacks. The company also earns income from consignment sales services and exports. Pricing strategies focus on maintaining brand value and profitability amid competitive pressures.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: CROWN CONFECTIONERY is one of the major players in the Korean confectionery industry, competing with companies such as Haitai Confectionery, Orion, and Lotte Wellfood. The industry is oligopolistic with high entry barriers due to scale and capital intensity. The company maintains a strong market position through brand equity and continuous innovation.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of 2023, the company reported sales of approximately 434.7 billion KRW, representing a 5.1% increase from the previous year, and operating profit of 28.4 billion KRW, a 61.7% increase. Total assets stood at about 338.6 billion KRW with equity of 204.8 billion KRW. The company shows steady growth supported by operational improvements and new production capacity.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: CROWN CONFECTIONERY emphasizes product quality, brand heritage, and innovation tailored to evolving consumer preferences including health-conscious and premium products. Its value proposition includes a diverse portfolio of long-established and newly developed brands, efficient nationwide distribution, and responsiveness to market trends such as wellness and premiumization.
